foundry_refs.desc: Literal visual match: The POET standing in dim teal bedroom moving toward rain window overlooking black car.
foundry_refs.line: The vape gathers, inside and out. My vision blurs. I move toward the window — and you only get further away.

foundry_refs.desc: Literal visual match: Blue fog billows across bedroom couch as POET raises arm in vocal defiance.
foundry_refs.line: More haze. What isn't mine, I still can not give.

foundry_refs.desc: Literal visual match: POET seated on brick roof ledge watching massive plumes of white exhaust steam rise.
foundry_refs.line: Before I go, I call on my mother — in tears, speaking of an abyss she's never known.

poems.title: Hot Minute
poems.note: The Belvedere, 1 E Chase St (1903) — the ballroom behind the old door

set_pieces.name: Taken by the haze
set_pieces.line: 14 HOT MINUTE · A Taken by the haze — “Don't make me leave and go where promises, hearts,”

set_pieces.name: Floating in the black
set_pieces.line: 14 HOT MINUTE · B Floating in the black — “I escaped here for a reason”

set_pieces.name: Cross-cut: highs and lows of life
set_pieces.line: 14 HOT MINUTE · C Cross-cut: highs and lows of life — “let it feel love and lost as we must endure”

set_pieces.name: Battle scars and graytones
set_pieces.line: 14 HOT MINUTE · D Battle scars and graytones — “can't leave behind the impulse that comes from battle scars”

set_pieces.name: The vintage door appears
set_pieces.line: 14 HOT MINUTE · E The vintage door appears — “I trust that you'll be fine.”

set_pieces.name: The dance at the vintage party
set_pieces.line: 14 HOT MINUTE · F The dance at the vintage party — “Our dance together is a victory to entwine muses”

set_pieces.name: Disappears into the crowd; door closes
set_pieces.line: 14 HOT MINUTE · G Disappears into the crowd; door closes — “and a genesis of a New Testament as it ends.”
